title: Egg Fried Rice
description: Eggs and cooked rice with peas, carrots, bell pepper and a side of lettuce. Preparation steps are a suggested method; review before saving.
steps: Chop the carrots and bell pepper. Wash and prepare the lettuce.
Cook the carrots, pepper and peas in a non-stick pan until tender.
Add the eggs and scramble until set.
Stir in the cooked rice and heat thoroughly.
Serve with lettuce and your choice of sauce.
